description:
Commit a machine-readable digitization that pins the selected published eBCH OSD curve plus its complete construction identity.

## Background

The reproduction target is eBCH $(128,64)$ on BI-AWGN/BPSK with BLER versus $E_b/N_0$, OSD order 2, and order 1 as a control. Fossorier1995 is authoritative and Yue2022 supplies an independent cross-check. The source pin determines the primitive polynomial rather than the plan.

## Success Criteria

- [hard] REQ-01: Identifies the exact Fossorier1995 page, figure, series, construction, channel, metric, and OSD order represented by the digitized data.
- [hard] REQ-02: Records the published reprocessing list order, naming the source's candidate enumeration order and tie policy for the digitized series.
- [hard] REQ-03: Pins the eBCH $(128,64)$ construction identity including primitive polynomial, extension convention, dimensions, and systematic matrix convention.
- [hard] REQ-04: Stores auditable $E_b/N_0$ plus BLER points with digitization method, precision, and provenance.
- [hard] REQ-05: Records the Yue2022 cross-check and material construction or curve differences without silently reconciling them.
- [hard] REQ-06: Distinguishes the published order-2 series from the campaign's order-1 control so the control carries no unsupported external claim.
title: Published eBCH OSD curve dataset
